scientific.integrity: Exact one-step Gaussian sketch distributions are derived using two orthogonal Gaussian directions; the divergence proof uses the reciprocal density near its pole, and the GMRES risk uses the Student second moment.
limitations: SPD real linear systems; one-dimensional Krylov subspace; Gaussian i.i.d. sketch.
Unconditional expectations without rejection, clipping, or regularization.
No claim about iterated convergence or the high-probability successful-embedding event.
Comparative GMRES second-moment statement requires sketch size greater than two.

title: An all-oversampling infinite-risk law for Gaussian-sketched FOM
